# Authority and evidence

Separate current-behavior evidence (code, configuration, tests, runtime output), approved-intent evidence (accepted requirements and decisions), delivery evidence (Git, issues, reviews, CI, releases), working-context evidence (chats, notes, drafts), and inference. A chat is not automatically approved; code is not automatically approved intent; passing tests prove only checks run.

When sources disagree, record the exact conflict, source and date, category affected, owner/decision needed, and next safe action. Preserve uncertainty.
